**GM Encoder** — VMAF-targeted video encoding for Unraid.
This repository provides **GM-Encoder**, a headless watch-folder transcoder. Drop videos into an input share and it finds the optimal CRF for your target quality using [terranvigil/dynamic-crf](https://github.com/terranvigil/dynamic-crf) + ffmpeg/libvmaf, encodes, and remuxes every original audio, subtitle, attachment and chapter stream.
Supports **NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD/Intel VAAPI and CPU** (libx265 / SVT-AV1), with an `auto` codec mode that detects the passed-through GPU.
Maintained by [turkushan490](https://github.com/turkushan490). Support: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/turkushan490/gm-encoder/issues).
